note: Rugby league's built-in earlier seasons (docs/design/rugby-league.md, "Earlier seasons"): the 2008 NRL season from Rugby League 2: World Cup Edition's own database, every player checked against the Rugby League Project's 2008 records; and the seasons 1998 to 2007 and 2009 to 2024 (`method` "computed"), which no game rated, computed from NRL.com's match centre ("Computed seasons"), whose `list` is the club's NRL.com nickname and `rlp` its Rugby League Project slug that season; `nrlcom` names each NRL.com team id's club (today's id, or a defunct club's own: `defunct`), the same in every season. Each map in `maps` serves the seasons whose clubs share its grounds (its `note` says how; "nrl" is today's map, built from scripts/data/nrl-teams.json, which its seasons must equal). node scripts/sync-rugby-league-seasons.mjs writes scripts/data/rugby-league-seasons/<id>.json from the inputs pinned in scripts/data/rugby-league-seasons-sources.json; node scripts/build-rugby-league-seasons.mjs builds each season's clubs; node scripts/build-club-maps.mjs --league=nrl builds each era's map from `teams` and `maps`. `teams` lists every club of a season by the database's name for it (`list`) and the Rugby League Project's (`rlp`, its first-grade season page, whose slug the season before shares, read only to say why a player is left out; `nyc`, its National Youth Competition one): `franchise` is today's club (a defunct club's own id, which no club of today's continues), `id` the season's own where the club has been renamed or moved since, `ground` where it played its home games (a ground it still plays at under its present name), `base` where a club that shared its ground trained, and `home` the [lon, lat] its territory grows from (English Wikipedia's coordinates; for 1998-2007 at the revisions `wikipedia` pins, the ground of most of its home games by NRL.com's draw, named as it was then unless still played at). `nations` are the season's World Cup nations, by the database's name, the game's nation id, RLP's World Cup squad heading and its Test team code: the sync checks their squads, but the season fields clubs only (docs/design/rugby-league.md, "Earlier seasons"); `carriedOver` the database's national squads that are older editions' and are not read; `nameFixes` a name the database spells with a character no name has.

maps.note: The twenty of 1998, the last season before the clubs were cut to fourteen: St. George and Illawarra apart, the Adelaide Rams, the Gold Coast Chargers, the North Sydney Bears, Balmain and Western Suburbs; Canterbury at Belmore, the Cowboys at Malanda Stadium.
Seventeen: the St. George Illawarra Dragons at WIN Stadium, no Adelaide or Gold Coast; the Canterbury Bulldogs at Stadium Australia from its opening (Accor Stadium today).

Fourteen: the Wests Tigers from Concord Oval, the Northern Eagles at Gosford (NorthPower Stadium), no South Sydney; the Bulldogs, by that name, at Stadium Australia; the Cowboys at Dairy Farmers Stadium.
The New Zealand Warriors by name; the Storm at Colonial Stadium; the Bulldogs at the Sydney Showground.

Fifteen: the Rabbitohs readmitted, at the Roosters' ground (Aussie Stadium) and growing from Redfern Oval; the Northern Eagles at Brookvale in their last season; the Storm back at Olympic Park Stadium.
Manly again in place of the Northern Eagles; the Broncos at Suncorp Stadium from its reopening; the Bulldogs at Stadium Australia (Telstra Stadium then) most weeks.
The Rabbitohs move to Stadium Australia, the Bulldogs' ground: both grow from their training grounds, Redfern Oval and Belmore Sports Ground.
Sixteen: the Gold Coast Titans join, at Carrara Stadium for their first season; the Sydney Football Stadium still Aussie Stadium at the season's start.
The sixteen of 2008 at their grounds of 2008 (`teams`), in 2009 too: the Bulldogs as "Bulldogs" from Sydney Olympic Park, the Storm at Olympic Park Stadium.
Canterbury-Bankstown again by name, still training at Sydney Olympic Park until it went back to Belmore in October 2011; the Storm at AAMI Park from its opening in 2010.

The Bulldogs grow from Belmore Sports Ground. A ground keeps its name of 2012 through the era (rule R3): Dairy Farmers Stadium, 1300SMILES Stadium by naming rights from 2013; the Sydney Football Stadium of 1988, Allianz Stadium by naming rights from 2012. The Eels keep Parramatta Stadium while it was rebuilt (rule R1: ANZ Stadium in 2017 and 2018; the new Western Sydney Stadium, on its site, from 2019), and so do the Roosters in 2019 (the SCG).

The Cowboys at the North Queensland Stadium (Queensland Country Bank Stadium) from 2020. The Roosters keep their own ground while it was rebuilt (rule R1: the SCG until the new Allianz Stadium opened in August 2022); the Warriors and the Storm keep theirs through COVID-19 (rule R2: the Warriors at Gosford in 2020 and 2021 and Redcliffe in 2022, the Storm on the Sunshine Coast in 2020). The Eels at the Western Sydney Stadium, CommBank Stadium today.
Today's clubs at today's grounds: the Dolphins join in 2023, and the Rabbitohs trained at the Heffron Centre from April 2023. Today's map, built once.

nrlcom.aliasNote: A player NRL.com lists under two ids plays under his first: Ben Nakubuwai is 503511 in the Titans' 2017 round 24 game and 100007912 in round 26; the Rugby League Project's 2017 Titans list has him once (22759). Pat O'Hanlon is 500987 for Parramatta in 2011 and 2013 (and Canterbury in 2014) but 500233 in 2012; RLP's Parramatta lists of 2011, 2012 and 2013 all have him as 17217. Matt King is 501172 for Melbourne in 2007 and South Sydney in 2012 but 501830 for South Sydney in 2013; RLP's South Sydney lists of 2012 and 2013 both have him as 738. Before 2009: Jamie Ainscough is 510193 for St. George and St. George Illawarra from 1998 to 2001 and 481 in a few of their games of 1999-2001 (RLP 390 in both seasons' lists); Tevita Amone 508487 for Western Suburbs in 1999 and the Cowboys in 2002, and 1035 in one Cowboys game of 2002 (RLP 1448); Willie Manu 1115 for the Wests Tigers, South Sydney and St. George Illawarra from 2001 to 2005, and 503118 in one or two games of each of 2003-2005 and in his four for the Sydney Roosters in 2015 (RLP 814 in every list).
nrlcom.fromNote: NRL.com's match centre keeps team lists and player stats from 1998 (`from`); its replies for the seasons before give scores only (1997's first game, checked 2026-11-13, and the research pass's census of 1990, 1995 and 1997), so a season before 1998 has no players: 1998's season before and its seasons two before are empty, as is 1999's two before. The defunct clubs keep the ids of NRL.com's draws (10002 the North Sydney Bears … 10060 Western Suburbs), which its match centre replies share; NRL.com files St. George's 1998 games under the St. George Illawarra Dragons' team (500022), so the 1998 Dragons are an era of that club.
nrlcom.terms: NRL.com's match centre (https://www.nrl.com/draw/), the NRL's data, credited as each computed season's provider. robots.txt (read 2026-11-09, and again on 2026-11-13 for 1997-2006 through scripts/lib/polite-fetch.mjs, which also reads it for Anthropic's crawlers): User-agent * with no Disallow. The terms of use redirect to an account sign-in, which was not followed, so they were not read; the replies state no licence. Fetched one request at a time, at least 1.2 s apart.

rlpTerms: The Rugby League Project (https://www.rugbyleagueproject.org/), © 2005-2026 Shawn Dollin, Andrew Ferguson and Tim Costello; no data licence stated. robots.txt (read 2026-11-09, and through scripts/lib/polite-fetch.mjs on 2026-11-13) disallows /matches/Custom, /matches/s|m|p|r/ and any URL with a query string; the season, club-season, competition and player pages read are allowed. Fetched one request every 3 s, and read for facts only: who played for a club, his date of birth and his positions.
defunctNote: Clubs of 1998–2007 that no club of today continues: `teams` names each by its own id, which is its `franchise` too, and NRL.com's team ids name it (`nrlcom.teams`). On an era map they rank after today's clubs, in this order; each plays in a colour of its own (scripts/lib/club-identity.mjs colourFor) and has no crest.
wikipediaNote: English Wikipedia articles read on 2026-11-13 for the clubs and grounds of 1998–2007 (names of the day, coordinates, who played where), each pinned to the revision read; the copies stay in the ignored data-src/rugby-league-seasons/wikipedia/.
